services.name: Official enrollment
steps: Present the requirements listed for your student type.
Take a queue number at the Registrar's Office.
Sign the enrollment form and receive your assessment.
Pay the assessment at the Cashier's Office before the deadline.
Submit your class assignment slip / adviser schedule.
services.source: DRAFT - walkthrough to be confirmed with the Registrar

services.name: Student clearance
steps: Go to the Guidance Office and request the clearance form.
Pay any outstanding accountabilities at the Cashier's Office and attach the receipt.
Have the Guidance Office sign and release the clearance.
Bring the released clearance to the Registrar's Office.
services.source: DRAFT - clearance route to be confirmed with the Guidance Office

services.name: Payment of assessment fees
steps: Get your assessment from the Registrar's Office or the student portal.
Pay at the Cashier's Office or through the online portal.
Keep the official receipt - the Registrar will ask for it.
services.source: DRAFT - payment channels to be confirmed with the Cashier

services.name: Scholarship application
steps: Get the application form from the Office of Student Affairs.
Attach the required documents and your Form 138.
Submit before the scholarship deadline and wait for the release of results.
services.source: DRAFT - scholarship window to be confirmed

services.name: Late enrollment
steps: Ask the Registrar's Office for the late enrollment form.
Explain the reason and attach proof.
Pay the late fee if the registrar approves the request.
services.source: DRAFT - late enrolment policy to be confirmed
